args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities (Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, Kailua Beach):
- Multiple swimsuits/swim trunks
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat or cap
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

Hiking & Outdoor Activities (Diamond Head, North Shore):
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Light jacket or windbreaker
- Hiking socks
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Trail snacks
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

Sightseeing & Cultural Activities (Pearl Harbor, Polynesian Cultural Center, Shopping):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Casual outfits (lightweight clothing)
- One slightly dressier outfit for the luau
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Portable phone charger
- Small backpack or crossbody bag

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid supplies
- Motion sickness medication
- Aloe vera gel (for potential sunburns)
- Lip balm with SPF
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Hairbrush/comb
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Electronics:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Universal power adapter
- Headphones
- Portable power bank

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel pillow for flights
- Books/magazines/e-reader
- Travel laundry detergent (small packet)
- Plastic bags for wet items
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)

Notes:
- Pack light, breathable clothing suitable for tropical climate
- Consider laundry options at hotel to reduce packing
- Check airline baggage restrictions before finalizing packing
